translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Matyiw
book.title: MATYIW Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Matyiw Tikak

content: Jiysis Nup Kiyŋ Chin Aŋgiy Dand Jerusalem Amniyak
Jiysis binuk gok yip Jerusalem maŋ maŋ giy, miñmon sikoy Betpasiy, Oliyp dum maŋ siŋak amjakiy, binuk omiŋal aŋgyokiy aŋgak,
“Nirmiŋay miñmon wikan bindoŋ amiy niŋniŋgayr: doŋgiy marip biynimb ma dand tapay bap nonim yip tiwniŋg ayey mindeniŋgamb. Miñ ak wisikiy poŋind winimiyr.
Pen biynimb gunap apiy yenen kanj doŋgiy chinup ak wisik dand amjipiyr aŋgeniŋgiy aŋgnimiyr, ‘Biyomb ak woŋg mindek aŋgamb diniŋg opur aŋger, yaw aŋgey dand winiŋgayr aŋgak.’”
Pen kuyipmiŋay yokek diniŋg amnirik kun ak, bi Gor minim aŋgep bap giniŋgamb aŋgiy tikak rek nep gak. Nuk aŋgak:

content.text: “Jerusalem biynimb kuyip aŋgnimimb, ‘Biyomb nimb ak doŋgiy ar bisgiy nimbip ker asaw. Nuk bi yikop rek bap doŋgiy ñiluk ar ak bisgiy asaw aŋgnimimb’ aŋgak.”

content: Pen Jiysis binuk aŋgyokek amnirik omiŋal kun ak, aŋgak aŋgak rek,
doŋgiy marip ak sek poŋind aperik, binuk gok chech tuŋgasikiy, doŋgiy marip ar ak ayeyak, ar kun ak bisgak.
Biynimb kuŋaynep Biyomb asaw aŋgiy, chech paryomb kiyk aryoŋ ay mindeyak gok tuŋgasik kinjeŋram ak ayak. Gunap am minj kas mon kas okok timbrik dapiy ayak.
Pen nup piŋiy kus kus giy amyiŋg aŋgyak:

content.text: “Depiyt tikek, tik dand amiy tikip ak owip biy. Niŋim! Gor nup yokek owip. Gor nup tep aspun aŋgyak!”

content: Jiysis Jerusalem amjakakniŋ, biynimb gok aŋg amiy apiy giy aŋgyak, “Bi kun ak an aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak, biynimb Jiysis yip wiyak gok aŋgyak, “Bi biy mey Jiysis; bi Gor minim aŋgep Nasaret Galiyliy propens nimb ak aŋgyak.”
Jiysis Biynimb Gor Aŋgniŋep Korip Biysniys Geyak Gok, Yuk Mis Yokak

Jiysis Gor aŋgniŋep korip miŋgan biyaŋ amiy: biynimb tap maker ay geyak gok, kuyip maŋgiysek yukyokiy, boŋg band maniy ay yimjik geyak gok tuŋgandikiy, bi yakir yokyiŋg cheya bisiŋg mindeyak gok tuŋgandikiy gak.
Kun giyiŋg, kuyip aŋg giy aŋgak, “Baybol buk tikyak ak, Gor aŋgak, ‘Korip yand ak yip aŋgniŋep.’ Pen nimb gispim ak, bi tap siydep kapkap weyiŋg mindpay korip bap rek ayip aŋgak.”
Pen Jiysis Gor aŋgniŋep korip miŋgan kun ak mindakniŋ, biynimb windin koy giy, tomb timey giy gak gunap apeyak, kuyip gek suŋ ayak.

Nuk tap mageprek gek, ñapan sikoy gok suk aŋgyiŋg aŋgyak, “Depiyt Ñinuk. Tap mageprek gipan! Wis-ey! aŋgyak.” Pen kiyk kun aŋgeyak, bi Gor nup tap simboŋgep yomb gok sek, bi low tiysa gok sek, kuyip miluk yimb yapek aŋgyak,
“Nip aspay ak niŋsipan? Aŋgey kirgiyaŋ aŋgyak.” Aŋgeyak Jiysis aŋgak, “Aspay ak niŋsipiyn ak pen; ñapan ŋaŋ gok kuyip gos tep ñen, yimb yip dand araniŋgambay aŋgiy tikyak ak ma niŋbim?”
Kun aŋgiy, kuyip kirgiy, am miñmon sikoy Beteniy kinak.
Jiysis Mon Kiyaw Bind Ak Aŋgek Milip Gak
Minek Jiysis andkind Jerusalem winiŋg, kinjeŋnamb okok apek yiwan gek,

kinjeŋram gol siŋak mon kiyaw bind bap niŋiy kiñiŋ siŋak amiy niŋak: maŋgiy ma piyak; kas gok nep mindek. Kun gek aŋgak, “Mon bind biy kisen maŋgiy ma yimb piyniŋgamb aŋgak.” Kun aŋgakniŋ, day kiyaw bind kun ak milip gak.
Binuk gok niŋiy, wal aŋgiy aŋgyak, “Yergiy mon kun biy kasek milip gisap?”

Aŋgeyak Jiysis kuyip aŋgak, “Pen niŋim! Chin aŋgon kunep ginimuŋ aŋgiy, gos okok ma niŋnimimb; Bapiy yomb nuk giniŋgamb aŋgiy, gos nokom niŋem, giniŋgamb. Pen kun anep mer; miñmon dum biy liŋg ñiŋg yomb namb siŋak amnaŋ aŋgem, gek amniŋgamb.
Gor chinup direp giniŋgamb aŋgiy aŋgniŋem, aŋgniŋgambim rek giniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Nip An Aŋgek Kun Girapan

Jiysis Gor aŋgniŋep korip ak amiy, biynimb gok kuyip minim aŋgñakniŋ, bi Gor nup simboŋgep yomb gok sek, bi minim tuŋgasikep gok sek apiy, nup aŋgyak, “Nip an kun ginimin, kun ginimin aŋgek, girapan?”
Aŋgeyak Jiysis pen aŋgak, “Nimbip minim bap aŋgniŋen, yip aŋgñem, pen an aŋgek girapiyn ak, nimbip aŋgñiniŋgayn.

Jon biynimb gok kuyip ap ñiŋg pikñak ak, gos nuk key niŋiy gak akaŋ, Gor aŋgek ap kun gak?” Jiysis kun aŋgek, kiyk key aŋgniŋ aŋgniŋ giy aŋgyak, “Chin Gor yokek ap gak aŋgoniŋgambun; chinup aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Kun ak Jon aŋgip ak yenen ma niŋdipim aŋgniŋgamb.’
Pen Jon gos nuk key niŋiy ap gak aŋgoniŋgambun; biynimb gok Jon bi Gor minim aŋgñemb apay rek chinup kuŋay aŋgniŋgambay aŋgyak.”
Kun aŋgiy Jiysis nup aŋgyak, “Chin ma yimb niŋbun aŋgyak.” Aŋgeyak kuyip aŋgak, “Yip ma aŋgñimbim rek yand pen, an aŋgek ap gispiyn ak nimbip ma aŋgñiniŋgayn aŋgak.”
Bi Mamiymiŋay Aŋgiy Paydoŋ Ay Aŋgak.
“Pen nimb yerip gos niŋbim? Bi bap ñinuk omiŋal mindeniŋgamb. Ñinuk nind ak nup miñiy wayn woŋg ak am gey aŋgek,
ma am giniŋgayn aŋgiy, kisen pen gos andikiy niŋiy, am wayn woŋg ak geniŋgamb.
Nop pen am ñi kisen anup kunep aŋgek, yaw giniŋgayn aŋgniŋgamb ak pen, ma am giniŋgamb.

Pen ñi omiŋal kun ak, an nop aŋgniŋgamb rek niŋdiniŋgamb?” Aŋgek Jiwda biyomb kun gok aŋgyak, “Ñinuk nind ak nop aŋgniŋgamb rek giniŋgamb aŋgyak.” Aŋgeyak Jiysis aŋgak,” Nimbip niŋind aspiyn: nimb yikop mindpikniŋ bi takes diy maniy yesek gunap dipay gok sek, kinjeŋram biyn gok sek Gor biynimb diy kond mindeniŋgamb kiñiŋ ak mindonjun aŋgiy, nimbip tawsak aysipay.

Jon bi ñiŋg pikñemb ak apiy nimbip, suŋ mindeniŋgambim minim ar ak aŋgñiyiŋgip ak pen; kindik ma gipik. Bi takes diy maniy yesek gunap dipay gok sek, biyn waŋ siy dipay gok sek minim kun ak niŋiy kindik giyak. Kiyk giyak kun ak niŋiy, nimb yenen gos kisenimb bap niŋiy, Jon nup minim ak ma dipik.
Jiwda Biynimb Sisker Giyak Ar Ak Paydoŋ Ay Aŋgak

Jiysis aŋgak “Miñiy minim paydoŋ ay bap sek aŋgniŋg gispiyn. Bi mankumb nop nimb bap miñ wayn woŋg ak gi yimiy wariy giy, miñ maŋgiy piksimbjakep kiwok bap gayniŋgamb. Gay, miñ maŋgiy ak ap siy ñiŋniŋgiy rek ayip ak niŋmindenjun aŋgiy, korip paryomb yiy akyoŋ bap giy; bi gunap kuyip miñ woŋg yip ak kond mindenimimb; kisen piy pik gek, yip gunap nimb gunap dinimimb aŋgiy, miñmon paryomb okok amniŋgamb.
Miñ maŋgiy ak pik gakniŋ, binuk gok kuyip, yip gunap am dand wim aŋgek,
kiyk amjakey, bi wayn woŋg gi mindeniŋgambay gok tikjakiy, bi bap nup gamb pikniŋgambay; bap nup kamb jiw pikniŋgambay, bap nup pisnep pikayey kumniŋgamb.
Kun gey bi miñ wayn woŋg nop nimb kun ak, bi tapin kaw bap pen aŋgyokniŋgamb. Aŋgyokek ameniŋgambay, bi miñ wayn woŋg geniŋgambay gok, kuyip kunep giniŋgambay.
Kun gey, bi wayn woŋg nop nimb ak, Ñiyand ak yoken mey, minim nup ak niŋniŋgambay aŋgiy, aŋgyokek amniŋgamb.

Amjakek, bi wayn woŋg gi mindeniŋgambay gok nup niŋiy, kiyk key aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Bi woŋg nop nimb ñinuk ak asaw biy. Nop tip ak diniŋg gisap rek nup pikayon kumek, kisen tap woŋg guniy maŋgiysek diniŋgambun aŋgniŋgambay.’
Kun aŋgiy, nup dand woŋgday gol okok amiy, pisnep pikayniŋgambay.
“Kun geniŋgambay, kisen bi woŋgday nop nimb ak apiy, kuyip yerer giniŋgamb aŋgak.”

Aŋgek Jiwda kay aŋgyak, “Bi timey giniŋgambay kun gok kuyip geniŋgamb, yiwur yomb yimb diy kumniŋgambay. Kisen pen biynimb tep gunap diy, kuyip miñ wayn woŋg nup dayeniŋgamb, woŋg kun ak giniŋgambay. Miñ maŋgiy pik giniŋgamb ñin ak, nup rek ak jiw dam ñiniŋgambay aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak Jiysis aŋgak “Ak niŋind apim. Baybol buk minim tikyak ak niŋbim rek ayip. Tikiy aŋgyak;

content.text: ‘Bi korip gep gok kamb ma dinjun aŋgiy kirgiyak ak; miñiy korip sap namb biyaŋ rek ak mindip. Gor kun gek niŋon, tep yimb gip aŋgyak.’

content: “Korip sap namb biyaŋ nup ma dipim kun ak, Gor nimbip Jiwda kirgiy, biynimb key okok nimb tap nup ñemb rek mindeniŋgambay gok kuyip diy kond mindeniŋgamb.
Biynimb kamb ar kun ak apyap pikniŋgambay gok kuyip tapin nep pikniŋgamb; biynimb kamb kun ak puŋgjiw apyapiy aybirikniŋgamb gok, pisnep piksimbjakniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Bi Gor nup simboŋgep yomb gok sek bi Peresiy gok sek, Jiysis minim paydoŋ ayak kun ak kuyip nep aŋgek,
nup miñ ayun aŋgiy gos niŋyak ak pen; biynimb gok Jiysis nup bi Gor minim aŋgep aŋgyak ak niŋiy, chinup kuŋay aŋgniŋgambay aŋgiy, nup tap bap ma giyak.
